cards.name: Vines
cards.notes: Released Sep 1 2025 (Season 75). Entangles the 3 highest-HP units in a 2.5-tile radius for 2.5s; grounds air units so ground troops can hit them. Damage: 405 total at launch (162 dps x 2.5s); Sep 5 2025 emergency nerf 162->134 dps (~335 total); further Oct 2025 nerf (numbers not found). Verified: cost/rarity/radius/mechanic; damage approximate.

cards.name: Ronin
cards.notes: Released Jul 6 2026 (Season 85 Honor & Exile). Melee, ground-only. Parry: every 3.5s blocks one incoming ground melee hit and reflects 200% of it; spawns with parry charged. Aug 2026 bug-fix: first hit time 0.3->0.4s. Damage sources conflict (371 vs 337 at L11); 337 is the more recent figure. Reduced tower damage multiplier (WIP note, unconfirmed).

cards.name: Minion Giant
cards.notes: Released Sep 7 2026 (Season 87 Minion Academy, Academy Antics album event). Flying building-targeter that spits toxin from 4 tiles. Launch 189 dmg; Sep 16 2026 nerf 189->168 (-11%). All figures community-sourced (LDPlayer/noff/trophycoach), not from Supercell notes.
